prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while turning left at an intersection. They reported immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and headaches, with pain radiating into the right trapezius and occipital region. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, most notably in rotation and extension, along with paraspinal muscle tenderness and guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or sensory changes in the upper extremities.

Over five visits, the patient received a course of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, and graded cervical range-of-motion exercises, supplemented by a home stretching and postural program. Pain intensity and headache frequency decreased steadily across visits, and cervical mobility improved to near-functional limits by the final session. Some residual stiffness with prolonged computer use persists, though the patient reports being able to resume most daily and occupational activities. Diagnosis remains cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder. Continued self-directed exercise and ergonomic adjustments are recommended, with re-evaluation as needed should symptoms recur or worsen.
